title: Dyson Vacuum Cleaner: [Box Damaged] V8 Advanced + Car Kit $255.20, V15 Detect Absolute & Floor Dok $638.40 Posted @ Dyson eBay
body:
Deal: Dyson Vacuum Cleaner: [Box Damaged] V8 Advanced + Car Kit $255.20, V15 Detect Absolute & Floor Dok $638.40 Posted @ Dyson eBay

[ozchappy] Is is worth buying a V8 in 2026?
Also, if anyone has used the Car Cleaning Kit, is it any good?
[okwchin] Use it all the time when vacuuming the car. Definitely helps to have the flexi hose and the narrow long hard plastic nozzle for between seats and under the seats. The hard brush is handy for carpets and mats. I now use a longer hose from Aliexpress but the brushes and long nozzle are useful. You would get by without the car set and use the stock head, just buy the longer flexi from aliexpress and that would do most of what you need.
[ozchappy] Thanks for the tip about AliExpress, there are plenty of cheap, useful looking accessories for the V8.
If the Dyson car kit is decent as you suggest, it might by the nudge I need to grab one of these if still available.
[PerthectDeal] Still using my Dyson DC35 I brought in September 2013 from Masters!
Battery still last long enough to clean.
So this is many years ahead upgrade.
[Neilzy] Our DC35's still kicking along as well, albeit relegated to all the sh*t jobs we dont want to dirty the v15 with and it does it with much gusto. Do it a favour and buy an aftermarket battery
[furyou] I really wonder why they're still pushing these 10 year old models
chances are you buy it and then the accessories will be obsolete and you can't get them anymore
I think next one I'm going to stay away from dyson
[Pcoder] Says in 2 days above. Code should come out on Sunday.
Box damage is a bit of a misnomer, and more of a thing not to piss off the other retailers.
[mindlessshopper] planning to buy dyson to replace my bulky ozito cordless vacuum, should I go for v8 which seems outdated or should i invest to the higher/newer version (if its an investment after all ?, is there a better brand that can match dyson ?"
[Meg4] I haven't found any brand with as much 3rd party support as Dyson. So I guess maybe go for the V8? V10 is pretty good too if you need the suction. I purchased the Dyson car + boat (basically a V8), purchased a 3rd party wand and head for around $150 total.
[mindlessshopper] I did look into the battery adapter for v8, quite interested with v8 because I can use my ozito battery on it.
[Kelpei] That's what I've been doing for the past 3 years. Best upgrade ever. This mod works on V8 but not newer models
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] V8 cyclone is gawjuss. Highly recommended
[Simon Wright] I would describe the V8 as an excellent secondary vacuum, whereas the V15 is good enough to be your only vacuum. (I suppose the V8 might be enough if you're in a small apartment, and the V15 might still be too small if you have a fully carpeted 4+ bedroom house.)
There are better value brands than Dyson, but at these prices maybe not.
[tunzafun001] Based on repairing heaps of these (I've probably gone through 30 odd hard rubbish throw outs). All been easy fixes.
Out of them all, we kept a V8. Basically where Dyson peaked..and you can use a drill battery down the track (newer models have extra cells/ higher voltage / get heavier/ crap that you dont need and doesn't help).
[montorola] This is like the apple of vacuum cleaners. Unnecessarily overpriced when the competition does the same thing for a fraction of the price.
[JoeOz] What would be the equivalent of the V15, Shark Powerdetect?
[PopCounty] Lol… got some Shark one from JB. Opened package and instantly regretted. Emptying bin was mess as suction was dumb. Got Dyson instead and, pricey but Ok for 5+ years investment.
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] Just like Apple they have good warranty and customer service.
[fusion17] Are there anymore slim models?
Sad i never got the v12 slim last yr. They all Seem discontinued.
[jmc787] Got a Dreame R10 recently for $123 on Amazon, not sure why anyone would pay double that amount for essentially for the same thing.
[Ayanami] Does it have the equivalent of the fluffy head for hard floors?
[jmc787] It works fine on my hard floors, its a vacuum cleaner. If you wanna pay double for one that has a "fluffy head" go for it.
[aarick] Still prefer Dyson. Got my inlaws a dreame few years back and it's just not as good.
[Del Boy] Damn, got the v15 on last weeks deal, missed out on $75 not waiting that bit longer
[BargainsGrabber] Spotted in the featured products in the upcoming Dyson eBay live event
[mathemagician] I wonder why there are no Gen5detect deals in the past 3 months. In the market for one. But tempted to buy the V15 at that price, must be ATL!
[Simon Wright] The Gen5detect is about 15% more suck, 15% more battery and 15% heavier. It's basically identical. Should have been named the V15.1
If it's only 15% more expensive, then it's probably a fair price.
[theg00s3] Gen5 is clearance so idk why they’re not reducing the price further
